- Torrent downloads: a magnet link failed at once with "Attempt to dereference null ... torrent_flags" and kept retrying (the torrent was handed to the engine without its options); fixed.
- Torrent downloads: several episodes of the same season pack (one torrent, a different file each) no longer fight over it: they share the torrent and its folder, each asks only for its own file, and the torrent leaves the session only when the last one is done or paused. Before, the first one to finish removed the torrent from under the others, and they stayed at 0/0.
- Torrent downloads: only the wanted file is asked for from the first moment, so the peers are not dropped once the file list arrives (a download sat for a minute before starting).
- Series and movies: the trackers of an add-on's stream reached the engine as "tracker:udp://..." and were useless, so peers came only from the DHT; they now go in as real tracker addresses, and a few public trackers are added to every magnet link.
- Torrent downloads: while the file list is on its way the row shows "finding peers (n)" and, when no peer sends yet, "no peers yet", instead of a still 0 MB.
- Torrent downloads: a padding file named by the link is skipped for the biggest real file; files are written plainly (no memory mapping) on the phone's shared storage; the torrent's working folder is removed once nothing uses it.
- Tested on a computer with the same engine code: one file, three episodes of one torrent at once, pause and continue, and a .torrent file all downloaded byte for byte.
